description: This file defines the InlineContentClipView class, which is a custom Android FrameLayout used to contain and manage InlineContentView instances. Its purpose is to ensure that InlineContentViews are visible only within a specified area of the screen, handling surface layering and clipping to prevent their surfaces from overlapping other parts of the app in unwanted ways.

classes.name: InlineContentClipView
classes.description: A custom FrameLayout that manages InlineContentView instances by clipping their surfaces within a specific area and handling surface layering to prevent visual overlap issues.

methods.name: InlineContentClipView
methods.description: Constructors for InlineContentClipView, initializing the background SurfaceView and setting default behaviors.

methods.name: setBackgroundColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the clipping surface and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: setZOrderedOnTop
methods.description: Adjusts whether the InlineContentView surfaces are placed on top or behind this view's window.

search-terms: Custom Android view for inline content
